training.checkpoint_selection: Library best checkpoint using only the consumed EPRI plus UK development split. The untouched v3 acceptance cohort is unavailable to training and selection.

evaluation.threshold_selection: All settings were copied from the earlier frozen technique studies before any v3 image inference. No v3 threshold tuning, relabelling or retry is permitted.

model_role: A single-class insulator localisation specialist initialised from the completed v1 UK-adapted checkpoint. It does not replace pole/crossarm localisation and does not classify material.
claim_boundary: Small prospective UK technique check with analyst visible-object references and source-evidenced telecom negatives; not expert inspection truth or UK population accuracy. Raw scores are uncalibrated and are not probabilities. Repeated crops are training views, not independent assets.
budget: One fixed 8-epoch Roihu gputest training run followed by one baseline/v2 evaluation on the untouched v3 cohort. No acceptance-selected retry, threshold change or hyperparameter extension.
